hints.title: Sign-Dependent Strategy
hints.text: If num is positive, sort digits ascending. If negative, sort digits descending to make the magnitude as large as possible.

hints.title: Handle Leading Zeros for Positives
hints.text: For positive numbers, swap the first non-zero digit to the front position to avoid invalid leading zeros.

hints.title: Construct Result
hints.text: Reassemble the characters into an integer and restore the negative sign if applicable.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(D log D) where D is number of digits (<= 15)
variables: D: number of digits in num
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations of digits takes O(D!) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting digits directly gives the lexicographically smallest magnitude in O(D log D).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Carefully handle positive, zero, and negative signs and leading zeros.

Java char array manipulation and sign restoration.
